L176@P5: 6. Test Conditions （测试条件）
L177@P5: 6.1 Standard Test Conditions 标准测试条件
L178@P5: Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this Product Specification should be conducted at temperature
L179@P5: 25°C±2°C and humidity under 65% RH.
L180@P5: 若无特别要求，此规格书上的产品测试条件均为温度：25°C±2°C；湿度：小于65% RH。
L181@P5: 6.2 Standard Charge Method 标准充电方式
L182@P5: The "Standard Charge" means charging the cell at a constant current of 1000mA until the voltage is 4.20V, and then
L183@P5: charged at a constant voltage of 4.20V until its current is less than 100mA. For test purpose, charging shall be performed
L184@P5: at 25°C±2°C.
L185@P5: “标准充电”即在环境温度为 25°C±2°C 的条件下，先以恒定电流 1000mA 充电至 4.20V，再以 4.20V 的恒
L186@P5: 压充电至电流小于 100mA。
L187@P5: 6.3 Standard discharge method
L188@P5:  标准放电方式：
L189@P5: The "Standard Discharge" means discharging the cell at a constant current of 1000mA until the voltage is 2.50V. For
L190@P5: test purpose, discharging shall be performed at 25°C±2°C.
L191@P5: “标准放电”即在环境温度为 25°C±2°C 的条件下，以恒定电流 1000mA 放电到 2.50V。

L421@P8: 8. Mechanical Characteristic（机械性能）
L422@P8: Test Item
L423@P8: 测试项目
L424@P8: Test Method
L425@P8: 测试方法
L426@P8: Criteria
L427@P8: 检验标准
L428@P8: 8.1 Drop Test
L429@P8: 跌落测试
L430@P8: A fully charged cell drop onto the flat concrete floor
L431@P8: from 1.0m height three times in a random direction at
L432@P8: 20±5°C. After the experiment placed at least 1h, the
L433@P8: appearance of the inspection.
L434@P8: 满电电芯从 1m的高度以随机的方向跌落至水泥地上
L435@P8: 3 次（从头部、尾部、侧面三个方向），实验后放置
L436@P8: 至少 1h 后进行外观检查。
L437@P8: No explosion, no fire
L438@P8: 不爆炸、不起火
L439@P8: 8.2
L440@P8: Vibration Test
L441@P8: 振动测试
L442@P8: The vibration shall be a sinusoidal waveform with a
L443@P8: logarithmic sweep between 7Hz and 200Hz and back to
L444@P8: 7Hz traversed in 15 minutes. This cycle shall be repeated
L445@P8: 12 times for a total of 3 hours for each of three mutually
L446@P8: perpendicular mounting positions of the cell. One of the
L447@P8: directions of vibration must be perpendicular to the
L448@P8: terminal face. The logarithmic frequency sweep is
L449@P8: increased from 7 Hz a peak acceleration of 1 gn is
L450@P8: maintained until 18 Hz is reached. The amplitude is then
L451@P8: maintained at 0.8 mm（1.6 mm total excursion） and the
L452@P8: frequency increased until a peak acceleration of 8 gn
L453@P8: occurs. A peak acceleration of 8 gn is then maintained
L454@P8: until the frequency is increased to 200 Hz.
L455@P8: 所使用的振动波形为正弦波，振动频率范围是
L456@P8: 7Hz~200Hz，并且在 15min 内恢复至 7Hz。电芯在 3
L457@P8: 个垂直的方向振动，每个方向重复 12 次，总共是 3h。
L458@P8: 其中有一个振动方向必须垂直于端面。振动频率从
